title: RAGChunk
description: RAG-ready text chunk with trust and structural metadata, produced by Project C and consumed by Project D.

chunk_id.description: Unique identifier for this chunk within the document or corpus.

document_id.description: ID of the document this chunk originates from.

source_fused_document_id.description: Identifier of the FusedDocument that produced this chunk.

source_paragraph_ids.description: List of fused paragraph_ids that were merged to form this chunk.

text.description: Text content of the chunk to be embedded.

heading_path.description: Hierarchy of headings/subheadings relevant to this chunk.

trust_metrics.description: Trust and noise scores at the chunk level (aggregated from paragraphs).

rag_readiness_score.description: Overall measure combining quality, noise, and structural suitability for RAG.

provenance.description: Fine-grained provenance for audits and debugging.

source_pipeline_run_id.description: Identifier of the end-to-end run that produced this chunk.

embedding.description: Optional embedding vector (Project D may populate this; Project C must not).

metadata.description: Arbitrary additional metadata for downstream RAG systems (tenant IDs, tags, etc.).
